title: Eight fail-empty source-bound wrappers over closed Rust populations

basis.head: e8bc1d809
basis.tree: dirty (the leg's own uncommitted files); the wrappers, populations and driver are the files this evidence lands with

mutation_drills: npm run mutate:<name> passed for all eight (planted absent name refused by source binding; unlistable path refused at --list; empty population refused)
findings: check:network-enrollment-continuity-plane is RED: its sequence-zero materialization lane (apps/hypervisor/scripts/verify-hypervisor-system-sequence-zero-materialization.mjs, an orphan script registered by no npm script and run by no CI job) fails its own FIXTURE SELF-TEST 'malformed atomically published readiness kills and reaps the complete owned process group' and then its TEARDOWN ledger assertion, both sandboxed and unsandboxed, before any held journey runs; the continuity population (8) and architecture contracts are green.

cargo test -p ioi-consensus (default targets) does not compile on this tree: example aft_hash_async_bench.rs lacks the AftTimeoutVoteV1 fields highest_qc_async_parent_proof_hash / locked_qc_async_parent_proof_hash; examples are a frozen AFT surface, so the M02.4 wrapper runs the lib tests with --features aft (322 tests), the configuration CI exercises.

Stale counts corrected: work_result is 20 tests (manifest said 16); recognized_effect::tests is 28 (the 'seven' was never enumerated); crash edges are 42 (21 phases x before/after; '34' predated two phases); ioi-finality proof-substitution tests are 10 (not 11). The daemon 'intent' family for M03.5 is governed_authority::portable_authority_intent_tests (9), not download_intent_tests.
